reason: The posted daily cleaning log, shoes off and the 25-kid cap are what I look for, and the first visit is free so I can check it out myself. After that I'd maybe do one paid drop-in a month, not a membership, since daycare costs already ate my budget.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so $15 plus the trip has to be worth it every time. I also want to see the place is actually clean before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from other parents confirming it's really clean, and a cheaper multi-visit option that makes the drive worth it.
